messages:
kevin_ops: Heads-up — vendor just reported 2x DOA H100s from the lot we received yesterday. serials look mismatched in the manifest, possibly customs reclass hold. can we triage?

lina_logistics: ugh. which AWB/serials? do we have photos?

kevin_ops: AWB 1Z999AA10123456784, vendor serials in the packing list: H100-AX12-9987, H100-AX12-9988. physical tags show H100-AX12-9989, H100-AX12-9990. vendor says DOA on their end. attaching photos in thread (uploaded).

tom_vendor: apologies — we've validated from our side and saw the manifest mapping error. initiating RMA and inbound recall for the two units. RMA ref: RMA-2026-0427-TV. we'll cover expedited return shipping.

jia_sre: can we schedule replacement slots in the eu-dedicated-pool next week? Those two were slated for batch 18. if replacements are delayed we'll need to reshuffle canaries.

sasha_pm: priority is avoiding customer impact — if vendor can loan temporary units (air-topup loaners) for 7–10 days that would help. what's cost uplift?

tom_vendor: we can provide 2 loaner H100s from an EU buffer for up to 10 days at no charge if we get the RMA AWB within 48h. only ask is we cover local inbound brokerage fee (~€120) or accept a credit later.

lina_logistics: customs flagged HS code mismatch which caused the hold in FRA. if vendor can reissue invoice with HS 8471.80 and mark as temporary loaner it should clear faster. also need broker contact to prepay to avoid extra demurrage.

transport-bot: NOTE: AWB 1Z999AA10123456784 currently listed as HOLD at FRA-CargoHub since 2026-04-27T03:12Z (Customs). Estimated release window 24-48h after corrected docs.

procure_bot: Quick cost check — expedited air uplift for loaners is billed at 1.6x standard rate. if we accept broker prepay, vendor offered to offset full brokerage fee against the replacement invoice.

jia_sre: ok please confirm we get tracked loaner serials and ability to pin them to eu-dedicated-pool units (hot-swap). need to avoid cache warmup blocking tests.

kevin_ops: tom — can you send corrected invoice + temp-loaner declaration and updated AWB paperwork to lina and cc: customs broker (listed below)? if vendor won't prepay brokerage we'll accept credit to replacement invoice.

tom_vendor: sending now. new invoice v2 and loaner declaration uploaded. AWB updated to: 1Z999AA10123456890 (loaner manifest). RMA label for returns: RMA-RET-3498 (please attach to the two DOA units).

lina_logistics: filed with broker. requesting waiver for container handling fee — hoping vendor can absorb that (~€45). also routing asks: split return via sea for cost, but replacement loaners must be air.

sasha_pm: decision: approve loaners, vendor covers brokerage & handling fees, we accept credit on replacement if any residuals. jia, reserve two uninterrupted hot-swap slots for Monday 08:00 CEST.

jia_sre: reserved and noted in oncall rota. will run warmup and health-check script after hot-swap: 

```
#!/bin/bash
# quick kv cache warmup
for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS -X POST "$REDDO_API/prefill" -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'; done
```

kevin_ops: thanks. tom — once loaners are in our hands we'll perform acceptance testing and then load replacements when RMA completes. please also confirm if there will be any price uplift on the replacements due to expedited processing.

tom_vendor: replacements priced at agreed PO rate. no uplift for replacements. loaners covered free for the 10d window as promised. we'll issue credit note if any brokerage was prepaid by you.

lina_logistics: closing loop — broker cleared AWB at 10:04 CEST, loaners out for delivery ETA 15:30 CEST today. RMA pickup scheduled for 48h. I'll update this thread if anything blocks customs or staging. :thumbsup:

kevin_ops: perfect. tagging @sasha_pm so we can update customer comms if warmup fails. thanks everyone.

sasha_pm: thanks team. will draft a brief internal blurb for impacted teams and a customer hold message only if acceptance fails.
